name: Those who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones

meaning.zh:
“住在玻璃房子里的人不应该扔石头”，意思是人不要对别人进行批评，特别是当自己也有类似缺点或问题时。

这个短语源自古老的谚语，旨在提醒人们要谨慎对待对他人的批评和指责，因为自身可能也存在类似的缺点或易受攻击之处。这种表达常用于提醒人们在批评他人之前要先检讨自己。
meaning.en: The phrase originates from an old proverb that serves to remind people to be cautious in criticizing or judging others, especially when they themselves may have similar flaws or vulnerabilities. It is often used to remind people to look at their own shortcomings before criticizing others.

lines.en: You shouldn't insult others about their behavior; *those who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.*
lines.zh: 你不应该因为别人的行为而侮辱他们；住在玻璃房子里的人不应该扔石头。

lines.en: He always criticizes his colleagues, but *those who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.*
lines.zh: 他总是批评他的同事，但住在玻璃房子里的人不应该扔石头。

lines.en: Before you judge me, remember that *those who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.*
lines.zh: 在评判我之前，记住住在玻璃房子里的人不应该扔石头。
